sources.games: 476 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 49.2%, hard support (STRATZ pos5, 9500 games). Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py crystal_maiden.
sources.items: No item rule: Glimmer Cape against magic lineups is 61% vs 52% of 31 games, too weak; build from the games.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: ward_dispenser 98% (4), magic_wand 82% (6), tranquil_boots 93% (8), aghanims_shard 58% (17), headdress 24% (22), glimmer_cape 56% (22), blink 50% (24), staff_of_wizardry 42% (24), force_staff 22% (25). Reviewed: Staff of Wizardry (a part, 42% at 24 min) dropped. STRATZ pos5 (9500 games) disagrees: Blink Dagger 22 min 83% (won 56%), Glimmer Cape 23 min 40%, Black King Bar 32 min 46% (won 60%); the league games have Blink in 50% and no Black King Bar at 25%+ (asked).

skills.basis: 476 games since 7.41: maxed crystal_maiden_frostbite > crystal_maiden_crystal_nova > crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura 212 (win 59.0%), crystal_maiden_frostbite > crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura > crystal_maiden_crystal_nova 91 (win 65.9%), crystal_maiden_frostbite > crystal_maiden_crystal_nova 64 (win 23.4%); talents 10: +200 Health 325/473 (48.6%), +12 Intelligence 148/473 (51.4%); 15: Frostbite Cast Range 219/275 (60.3%), Crystal Nova Cooldown 56/275 (67.9%); 20: Freezing Field Damage 33/48 (63.6%), Glacial Guard Mana Spent To Barrier 15/48 (73.3%); 25: Frostbite Duration 3/5 (66.7%), Crystal Nova Damage 2/5 (50.0%).

notes.basis: Valve Freezing Field (fetched 2026-11-07): a 10 s channel (can_move 0, 90-100 s cooldown); Frostbite (6-9 s cooldown) stops movement and attack for 1.5-3 s and is considered a root. High-rank Crystal Maidens won 41.5% of 82 games against Slark, Phantom Assassin or Spirit Breaker (49.2% overall).

reason.en: {enemy} jumps onto casters: Freezing Field is a 10 s channel you cannot move in, so start it only with your team around you and keep Frostbite for the one who jumps
